personality.description: This person tends to explore new ideas eagerly while still organizing life with careful plans, checklists, and close attention to details. They usually respond to moral dilemmas by thinking them through calmly, weighing both principles and consequences before making a firm but fair choice. In group discussions, they speak with steady confidence, listen well, and contribute thoughtful, well-structured points without dominating the conversation. They are generally cooperative, yet will clearly defend their position when they believe it is justified.
traits: has achieved positions of leadership through exceptional performance and abilities
focuses on fostering positive relationships and teamwork
cares a lot about what others think of them
takes input from others on how tasks should be accomplished
is quick to find common ground between other people's ideas and their own
